minutes.headline: Committee planned the September business meet-and-greet: food, drinks, donations, tasks assigned, and next meeting set.
minutes.summary: The Economic Development Committee spent most of the meeting planning a business meet-and-greet for local business owners and town officials: food, alcohol, sponsorships under ethics limits, tables, chairs, name tags and a short greeting program. Members also heard updates on local businesses, a solar parking-lot bylaw effort and the Master Plan. No formal votes were audible; a next meeting was agreed.

budget_items.what_was_said: A fundraiser raised money for the LBA; dumpsters were donated but a tipping fee was still paid.
The committee has no budget and the planning department budget covers only office supplies and training, so no town fund exists for sodas or water.
Members agreed to make personal donations toward event costs, with a gift card handed over for purchases.
Municipal employees cannot solicit donations but can publicize donation opportunities; ethics rules noted.

decisions.decision: Six tables needed; Parks and Rec to be asked for tables.
Task assignments: business card holders and name tags purchased, a church asked about chairs, reminder email two weeks out to bring business cards.
Town social media will post that donation opportunities exist for food and beverages; the town can supply water.
Chair to give a short welcome and the program; a printed program sheet to be on the table.
Next committee meeting set for Thursday September 14 at six o'clock.
If alcohol is served, beer and wine only.
